children.description: Bruunilla nealae is a deep-sea scale worm that is known from a single specimen collected from the Clarion-Clipperton fracture zone in the Pacific Ocean from a depth of about 5000 m.

children.name: Benhamipolynoe antipathicola
children.description: Benhamipolynoe antipathicola is a deep-sea scale worm that has been reported from the Pacific and Atlantic Oceans from depths of 128 to almost 500m.

children.description: Eulagisca gigantea is a species of scale worm commonly known as the Antarctic scale worm.

children.name: Eulagisca uschakovi Pettibone, 1997
children.description: Eulagisca uschakovi is a giant scale worm known from the Antarctic, in waters such as off Mac.Robertson Land, Palmer Archipelago and the Weddell Sea, at depths of 10 to 920m.

children.name: Lepidonotus squamatus
children.description: Lepidonotus squamatus is a species of polychaete worm, commonly known as a "scale worm", in the family Polynoidae.

children.description: Leucia nivea is a species of polychaete worm, commonly known as a "scale worm", in the family Polynoidae.

children.name: Neopolynoe acanellae
children.description: Neopolynoe acanellae is a scale worm known from the North Atlantic Ocean at depths about 400 to 2000 m.
